shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright slab with rounded/curved top
horizontal register divisions across the surface
repeated row of small elements along the upper part
arms and hands rendered in relief
justification: Both are upright rounded-top slabs bearing shallow relief organised into stacked horizontal registers, with a repeated row of small motifs across the top and figural/limb elements below, which gives a loose compositional echo. But the depicted content differs fundamentally: A shows naturalistic seated and standing human figures in profile with offering furniture and a band of script signs, while B shows a schematic, largely abstract composition of arcs, a belt-like band, angular zigzag/meander patterning and a stylised pair of arms and hands with no human faces or narrative scene.
